messages:
Alex Kim: Kickoff — readiness sprint for Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus marketplace launch. Goal: finalize connector artifacts, marketplace docs, and joint comms by end of next sprint.

Nora Li: I'll own Snowflake data model validation and Snowpark example notebooks. Need a mapping doc for nested VARIANT columns.

Diego Alvarez: Databricks side handled. Will prepare Delta Live Table recipe and tests. Requesting connector container tag and compat matrix.

Fatima Khan: Milvus validation and index tuning. Suggest we capture recall curves for ann index params (nlist, nprobe). Also confirm embedding dims.

legal-bot: legal-approval request created (REQ-2026-827). Current status: awaiting partner SCO signature.

Alex Kim: Timeline proposal:
```
Day 0-3: infra smoke + compatibility checks
Day 4-10: partner validation runs (2 partners, 1 internal)
Day 11-13: docs + marketplace assets
Day 14: soft partner-only listing + partner webinar
```

Nora Li: For the Snowpark examples, using sample dataset `retail_events_2026` — anonymized. I'll post ingest script.

Diego Alvarez: Infra note: need GPU-backed nodes for embedding perf (p4dn.8xlarge equivalent) for one day per run. I'll open quota request.

Fatima Khan: Milvus perf checklist: test HNSW + IVF_FLAT, batch sizes [16,64], measure p95 latency and recall@10. I'll upload the checklist.

Alex Kim: GTM: we should schedule a partner webinar and publish a tech brief. @Fatima will you help with demo script? @Diego with notebooks?

Fatima Khan: Yep, I'll draft demo steps. Also recommend we script a teardown to keep partner clouds tidy.

Diego Alvarez: I'll coordinate notebooks and CI jobs. integrations-bot: build #7721 succeeded: connector-milvus:v1.4.2 -> staging

integrations-bot: deploy #7730 queued for partner staging env

Nora Li: Blockers: need partner access to staging Snow account — partner onboarding form pending.

Fatima Khan: Blocker: Milvus cluster size for perf runs — ops approval pending.

Alex Kim: Okay noted. I'll chase partner onboarding and ops approvals. Booking 30m sync Mon 9am PT. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
